name: codex-br
description: Run OpenAI Codex on Amazon Bedrock (model openai.gpt-5.6-sol, provider amazon-bedrock) instead of the ChatGPT backend, via a `br` Codex profile. Adds /codex-br task (delegate a coding/diagnosis/research task), /codex-br review (built-in reviewer), and /codex-br adversarial-review (steerable challenge review). Defaults to maximum reasoning effort (ultra).
